opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Cara helps academics from any country who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death.
opportunities.summary: A rescue mission providing temporary refuge placements (postdoctoral or PhD) at universities and research institutions for academics at risk, so they can continue their work until they can return home. Cara checks applications, helps negotiate placements, allocates additional funding, and assists with visas and practical arrangements for the academic and accompanying family members.
